title: 第七章 黑恶会第八章 前往罗兰庄园
slug: 开局a级禁物玩家给我打工

巷口的黑骷髅酒馆传来淡淡的劣质烟草和血腥味。
伊莱娜双眼紧闭，双手摆成三角形放在眼前。
这是观星者的技能——回响。
在一定范围内通过感知来确定地形、建筑构造、敌人的数量和强度。
“里面有十七个普通人，二楼东侧有一个序列9超凡者，大概是他们老大。”
林奇靠在黑骷髅酒馆那年久失修的砖墙上，红色风衣的下摆沾着赶来路上溅起的污水。
他正在慢条斯理的给那柄带着花纹的银色左轮手枪上弹。
“先解决普通人吧，话说你有杀过人吗？”林奇将上完弹的审判插进腰间，拿出了夹在手臂下的长剑。
“没有...但我下定决心了。”伊莱娜有些紧张的深吸了一口气。
“作战开始。”
话音刚落，林奇便猛的一脚踹开了酒馆的大门，冲着里面发呆的人群大喊一声：“你们现在就可以逃跑了，我给你们五秒钟的时间。”
酒馆里的人看着穿着奇怪的两人，经过了几秒钟的呆滞后猛地爆发出笑声。
“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈，这是什么？考斯普雷？”
“哈哈，看看那个小个子，她好像缪斯寡妇家那个呆傻的小子偷穿他妈妈的衣服。”
“哈哈，这是哪里来的两个蠢蛋敢来黑骷髅闹事？”
“小子，我们的老大可是超凡者，不想死的话就快跑吧。”
林奇并没有理会他们的嘲笑。
“唉——”他叹了一口气，“我可以理解为你们已经做好了面对死亡的准备吗？”
“臭小子你还是回到你妈妈的怀里吃奶吧！”

唰——
一道剑芒闪过，刚刚大叫着冲向林奇的大汉倒在了林奇脚下。
喷涌的鲜血洒在了道路两旁的桌子上，大汉被砍飞的头颅上还带着惊恐的表情。
在他失去意识之前他只看到一道光，那道光带着死亡的味道来到了他的脖颈处。
咚。
头颅落地。
“时间到咯。受死吧，红蛋们。”
“玛德，杀了他们。”
伴随着黑帮混混们缓过神，离林奇两人最近的三人从怀中掏出了手枪。
然而他们并没有注意，无形的丝线已经缠绕在了他们手枪的枪口之上。
砰砰砰！
三声枪响，站在原地的林奇什么事都没有，反而是开枪的人额头上多了一个窟窿。
“是...超凡者...快跑！”
“快去通知老大！”
伊莱娜也没闲着，她伸出左手，指尖星光化作五点寒光射出。
群星标记！
被标记的目标行动轨迹会在伊莱娜的视野中留下银色残影。
“拂晓星轨秘剑第一式——织网！”伴随着伊莱娜的一声娇喝，半空中出现了密密麻麻的银色剑光。
噗噗噗。
剑光闪过，鲜血喷涌。

伊莱娜在剑光之后如同一头雌豹迅速朝着下一个敌人冲去。
“居然是快剑吗？”正在与几个混混搏斗的林奇感叹。

The faint smell of low-quality tobacco and blood came from the Black Skull Tavern at the entrance of the alley.
Elena closed her eyes tightly and placed her hands in a triangle in front of her eyes.
This is the stargazer's skill - echo.
Determine the terrain, building structures, and the number and strength of enemies within a certain range through perception.
"There are seventeen ordinary people inside. There is a Sequence 9 Transcendent on the east side of the second floor, who is probably their boss."
Lynch leaned against the dilapidated brick wall of the Black Skull Tavern, and the hem of his red windbreaker was stained with the sewage splashed on the way there.
He was slowly loading the patterned silver revolver.
"Let's deal with the ordinary people first. Have you ever killed anyone?" Lynch inserted the loaded Judgment into his waist and took out the long sword tucked under his arm.
"No...but I'm determined." Elena took a deep breath nervously.
"The battle begins."
As soon as he finished speaking, Lynch kicked open the door of the tavern and shouted at the dazed crowd inside: "You can run away now, I'll give you five seconds."
The people in the tavern looked at the two people in strange clothes, and after a few seconds of silence, they burst into laughter.
"Hahahahahahahaha, what is this? Cosprey?"
"Haha, look at that little one, she looks like that silly kid from Widow Muse's house who stole his mother's clothes."
"Haha, where did these two idiots dare to come to Black Skull to cause trouble?"
"Boy, our boss is an extraordinary person. If you don't want to die, just run away."
Lynch ignored their jeers.
"Alas -" he sighed, "can I understand that you are ready to face death?"
"You brat, you'd better go back to your mother's arms and feed yourself!"
Swish——
A flash of sword light flashed, and the big man who had just shouted and rushed towards Lin Qi fell at Lin Qi's feet.
The gushing blood was sprinkled on the tables on both sides of the road, and the big man's chopped-off head still had a look of horror.
Before he lost consciousness, he only saw a ray of light, which came to his neck with the smell of death.
Boom.
The head fell to the ground.
"It's time. Go to hell, you red eggs."
"Mader, kill them."
As the gangsters recovered, the three people closest to Lynch took out pistols from their arms.
However, they did not notice that the invisible thread had been wrapped around the muzzle of their pistol.
Bang bang bang!
Three gunshots were fired, and nothing happened to Lynch who was standing there. Instead, the shooter had a hole in his forehead.
"It's... a transcendent person... run!"
"Go and notify the boss!"
Elena was not idle either. She stretched out her left hand, and the starlight on her fingertips turned into five points of cold light and shot out.
Marked by stars!
The marked target's movement trajectory will leave a silver afterimage in Elena's field of vision.
"The first form of the Secret Sword of Dawn Star Orbit - Weaving a Web!" Following Elena's shout, dense silver sword light appeared in the air.
Puff puff puff.
The sword flashed and blood spurted out.
Elena rushed towards the next enemy like a female leopard after the sword light.
"Is it actually a fast sword?" Lin Qi, who was fighting with several gangsters, sighed.
